team.title: Hiring team
team.description: The job's Hiring Manager — approves candidates, signs off the job description, and makes the final interview decision.
team.missing: This job has no Hiring Manager, so every approval gate is CLOSED. An HR Admin needs to assign a Hiring Manager.
team.inactive: Hiring Manager {{name}} is no longer active (account locked or role changed), so every approval gate is CLOSED. An HR Admin needs to transfer the job to another Hiring Manager.
team.primaryHint: The person whose sign-off gates this job's pipeline. Cannot be removed — only an HR Admin can transfer it.
team.selectHint: People in the job's department are listed first. This is only a hint — department never decides access.
team.addError: Could not add this member to the job.
team.removeError: Could not remove this member from the hiring team.

transfer.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the previous Hiring Manager moves to another project from Oct 1.
transfer.hint: Pending work (JD sign-off, candidates awaiting approval, results to confirm) moves to the new person, and the previous Hiring Manager's availability no longer counts. Both people are notified.
transfer.error: Could not assign or transfer the Hiring Manager.

signOff.prompt: This job description is waiting for your sign-off before the posting goes live.
signOff.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. salary below market, missing distributed-systems experience requirement...
signOff.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. The job goes back to the Recruiter to edit and resubmit.
signOff.error: Could not record the sign-off decision.

status.pending: Waiting for {{name}} to sign off the job description.
status.rejected: {{name}} requested changes — the job went back to the Recruiter to edit and resubmit.
status.bypassed: Published by an administrator without {{name}}'s sign-off.

gate.title: Hiring Manager approval
gate.description: This candidate needs {{name}}'s approval before an interview can be scheduled.
gate.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Be specific so the recruiter and later rounds can refer back to it.
gate.bypassReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Hiring Manager on leave until Sep 10, role is urgent.
gate.bypassHint: The reason is written to the audit log and the bypassed Hiring Manager is notified. Minimum 10 characters.
gate.waiting: Waiting for {{name}} to review this candidate.
gate.requestError: Could not send this candidate to the Hiring Manager.
gate.bypassError: Could not bypass the approval gate.
gate.approveBody: The application moves to the recruiter's scheduling queue. The candidate is not notified until an interview time is booked.
gate.approveRound1Test: Round 1 is an online test — you don't need to attend, so the recruiter can schedule it right away.
gate.approveHasWindows: The recruiter will book the round 1 interview inside the hours you declared under “My available hours”.
gate.approveNoWindows: You haven't declared any hours for round 1. You can still approve, but the recruiter can only book an interview once you add hours under “My available hours”.

emails.title: Email history
emails.description: Exactly what left the system for this candidate, including automatic emails.
emails.empty: No emails have been sent to this candidate yet.
emails.loadError: Could not load the email history.
emails.editedHint: Staff changed the content from the template before sending.
